chunks: The best of what is cast into the heart is certainty.

key_terms.الْقَلْبِ: the heart, the inner spiritual center of a person

ai.seo_question: What is the best thing that can be placed in the heart according to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that yaqīn, or certainty, is among the greatest inner qualities granted to a human being. It points to the heart as the seat of firm faith, spiritual clarity, and unwavering trust in Allah.
